description: Tasks in eHour. With project_id: the tasks of that project (GET /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/tasks). Without: all projects with their tasks and client in a compact form (GET /api/v1/projects/tasks), optional filter on project, client and task fields (e.g. 'task_name$like:*Montage*'). Read-only.
name: list_ehour_tasks
